Third-party software in every Reveille HTML report

The report embeds the plotly.js 4.1.1 cartesian bundle. The packages below are
the ones its source requires, and their dependencies, traced from plotly.js at the
same version. Each one's licence follows, as that package publishes it, with line
endings and trailing spaces normalised.
